news.headline: Home of Bangladesh’s former leader Muhammad Yunus set on fire
news.summary: The blaze broke out during heightened violence before ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's planned return.

news.headline: PM credits economic successes to 'productive partnership' between political, military leadership
news.summary:
<p>Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday said Pakistan’s economic achievements were the product of a “productive partnership between the military and the political hierarchy”.</p>
<p>He was addressing a ceremony organised by the American Business Council of Pakistan.</p>

news.headline: Nigeria: States set to get their own police forces
news.summary: Nigeria has moved a step closer to letting its 36 states set up their own police forces. news.headline: Netanyahu Associates Acknowledge Role in Setting Off Election Day Arrests
news.summary: After a historic result for Israel’s Arab-led parties, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the vote was rigged, pointing to the detention of three opposition activists. His chief of staff has admitted being involved with the initial outreach to police.

news.headline: French 2027 presidential race: Green leader Tondelier draws closer to hard-left Mélenchon
news.summary: Six months before the first round of France’s presidential election, Green party leader Marine Tondelier is moving closer to Jean-Luc Mélenchon, the leader of the radical left.
